tasks.goal: Resolve the pinned pre-scan blockers so the full executed scan starts from a complete compile surface: (1) the 4 'genuinely untraceable' grid refusals from T037 (gn_finalize's (n,g) axes visible only as the view product n*g; grouped_gemm's sum over an unsigned case-shape axis spanning groups=3/4 in one identity) — investigate whether they are reducible within the declared launch contract: the kernel's program_id usage may be linear over the product (grid-stride), another view/scalar may carry the split, or the case-layer expression may be re-derived; if a case is truly not lowerable without extending the runtime launch protocol (e.g. passing grid axes as launch arguments), raise a DESIGN_ISSUE with the exact evidence (operators, shapes, the untraceable inputs, the proposed contract change) instead of forcing a fix; (2) the deconv3d typical-case compute defect pinned by T037 (compiles but computes wrong results on the typical case — reproduce minimally, walk the declared pipeline stages to the first incorrect stage, fix there; never patch the emitter to compensate); (3) the gqa 1-worker CSE segfault pinned by T030 (reproduce with passes enabled at threads=1, find the illegal rewrite, fix the CSE legality or the mis-typed value; the general path with passes off must stay green); (4) verify the fp64 tl.dot refusal's justification is recorded against the corpus's declared dtype surface (the case's declared dtypes and the FRONTEND_COVERAGE/declared-surface rows), so it reads as declared-unsupported with evidence rather than an open refusal.
outputs: Resolved pre-scan blockers (or a filed DESIGN_ISSUE for the launch-contract question) with regression tests
acceptance: Each of the 4 untraceable grid refusals is either repaired (the operator compiles and its cases execute and compare PASS at 1 and 4 workers) or carried into a filed DESIGN_ISSUE with the exact evidence (operator, shapes, untraceable inputs, why the current launch contract cannot express it, the proposed change); no silent residual.

The deconv3d typical case executes and compares PASS after a fix located at the first incorrect pipeline stage (the minimized reproduction and stage attribution are recorded); no other case regresses.

The gqa case executes and compares PASS at 1, 2, 4 and 8 workers with the passes enabled (the segfault is gone; the CSE legality fix has a regression test reproducing the illegal rewrite shape); the passes-off path stays green.
The fp64 tl.dot refusal's justification is recorded in the declared-surface/coverage records naming the corpus declaration it rests on.
All pre-existing test files still pass.
tests: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; python3 a100c/tests/test_compile_sweep.py --operator <the owned operators> (blockers resolved or DESIGN_ISSUE filed)
